## MigrateOptions.initialStash property

Initial preserved fields to include in the migration context. Use this to pass stash from a previous migration to restore preserved values. Typically you'd pass `previousResult.preservedFields` here.

**Signature:**

```typescript
initialStash?: readonly PreservedField[];
```
